title: Rational torsion on simple genus two Jacobians
summary: We exhibit new subgroups of rational torsion points in geometrically simple Jacobians of genus-two curves over $\mathbb Q$. The largest group, which has order 96 and invariants [2,2,2,12], is realized by curves of the form $y^2 = x(x-a^2)(x-b^2)(x-c^2)(x-u^2)(x-v^2)$ where $a,b,c,u,v$ are positive integers that satisfy $a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = u^2 + v^2$ and $a^4 + b^4 + c^4 = u^4 + v^4$. We also find realizations of the groups [2,2,20], [2,2,4,4], [2,2,2,8], [2,4,8], and [6,6].
